item.title: NEWT GINGRICH: A Year Long Celebration Of America’s Birthday
item.description: As we begin to wrap up 2025 with Christmas presents and New Year’s Eve parties, it is naturally time to think ahead to 2026.

item.title: Abrego Garcia Makes TikTok Videos As DHS Stays Silent Under Gag Order
item.description: Kilmar Abrego Garcia has been creating TikTok videos while the Trump administration has been forced to keep quiet under a federal judge's gag order.

item.title: Scott Jennings Calls Immigration Trump’s ‘Biggest Promise Fulfilled’ In 2025
item.description: Salem Radio Network host Scott Jennings told "This Week" guest host Jonathan Karl on Sunday that President Donald Trump's efforts to address illegal immigration represented his "biggest" fulfillment of a campaign promise in 2025.

item.title: Bernie Sanders Repeats Call For Data Center Moratorium As Pushback Against ‘Oligarchs’
item.description: Independent Vermont Sen. Bernie Sanders repeated his call to halt artificial intelligence (AI) data center construction Sunday, and proposed billionaires adopt certain left-wing policies.

item.title: YouTuber Nick Shirley Exposes Alleged Somali Daycare Center Which Reportedly Reaped $4,000,000 From Taxpayers
item.description: YouTuber Nick Shirley posted video Friday showing multiple purported Somali-run day care centers in Minnesota, including one which reportedly received $4 million in taxpayer funds, which did not immediately appear to have any children there.

item.title: New Poll Reveals Which Politicians Democrats Prefer Over Santa Claus
item.description: Democrats favor Independent Vermont Sen. Bernie Sanders and former Vice President Kamala Harris over both a selection of other prominent Democrats and even Santa Claus, according to a JL Partners poll for the Daily Mail released Sunday.

item.title: Somali Scammers Allegedly Stole Almost As Much In Minnesota As Entire Somalia GDP
item.description: The amount of fraudulent billing in Minnesota's Medicaid programs could be as high as $9 billion, Assistant United States Attorney Joe Thompson said Dec. 18.

item.title: STEVE MILLOY: Trump Puts Coal In National Energy Stocking
item.description: We are experiencing a national energy crisis that originated out of the Obama and Biden regimes’ war on coal. That crisis has been exacerbated by Biden’s Green New Scam. President Donald Trump took two important steps last week toward fixing both problems.

item.title: DANIEL MCCARTHY: JD Vance Gets America’s Creed And Heritage Right
item.description: With America's 250th birthday as an independent nation coming up in 2026, the big debate on the right this season about what it means to be an American couldn't be more timely.

item.title: ‘I’m On The Side Of Peace’: Trump Optimistic For ‘Very Close’ Russia-Ukraine Peace Deal After Zelenskyy Meeting
item.description: President Donald Trump expressed his continuing hope during a Sunday press conference at Mar-a-Lago that a peace deal could be reached between Russia and Ukraine.
